cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a quiet orbital recreation room with a tabletop wire-loop steady-hand puzzle and a small unlettered indicator lamp — she tests her famous precision on a harmless wire-loop puzzle; her compact orbital apartment's utility alcove — she stops a newly laundered sock drifting into a ventilation grille by trapping it gently under an empty mesh laundry basket; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; an airport lounge — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — standing; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — carries a small red paper lantern by its cord; a starship data archive — standing; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — turns a page of a book lying open on the table; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a nightclub with a dance floor under moving coloured lights and a velvet-rope queue at its door — standing
